CompleteOrderedField.content:
class CompleteOrderedField where
  R       : Type
  NatAlt  : Type
  zero_nat : NatAlt
  Succ : NatAlt -> NatAlt
  NatAltle : NatAlt -> NatAlt -> Prop

  zero    : R
  one     : R
  add     : R → R → R
  mul     : R → R → R
  opp     : R → R
  inv     : R → R
  Rle     : R → R → Prop
  Rlt     : R → R → Prop
  Rabs    : R → R
  INR     : NatAlt → R

  NatAltle_n : ∀ n : NatAlt, NatAltle n n
  le_succ_of_le : ∀ n m: NatAlt, NatAltle n m → NatAltle n (Succ m)
  le_succ : ∀ n : NatAlt, NatAltle n (Succ n)

  add_comm      : ∀ x y : R, add x y = add y x
  add_assoc     : ∀ x y z : R, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)
  add_zero      : ∀ x : R, add x zero = x
  add_opp       : ∀ x : R, add (opp x) x = zero
  mul_comm      : ∀ x y : R, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc     : ∀ x y z : R, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one       : ∀ x : R, mul x one = x
  dist_l        : ∀ x y z : R, mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)
  sub_zero      : ∀ x : R, add x (opp zero) = x
  Rle_refl      : ∀ x : R, Rle x x
  Rle_trans     : ∀ x y z : R, Rle x y → Rle y z → Rle x z
  Rle_antisym   : ∀ x y : R, Rle x y → Rle y x → x = y
  Rlt_def       : ∀ x y : R, Rlt x y ↔ (Rle x y ∧ x ≠ y)
  Rle_abs       : ∀ x : R, Rle (add x (opp zero)) (Rabs x)
  Rinv_0_lt_compat : ∀ x : R, Rlt zero x → Rlt zero (inv x)
  Rplus_le_compat_l : ∀ x y z : R, Rle y z → Rle (add x y) (add x z)
  Rinv_involutive   : ∀ x : R, Rlt zero x → inv (inv x) = x
  INR_pos       : ∀ n, Rlt zero (INR (Succ n))
  INR_le        : ∀ m n, (NatAltle m n) → Rle (INR m) (INR n)
  INR_0         : INR zero_nat = zero
  INR_S         : ∀ n, INR (Succ n) = add (INR n) one
  Rtotal_order  : ∀ x y : R, Rlt x y ∨ x = y ∨ Rlt y x
  Rle_inv_contravar : ∀ a b : R, Rlt zero a → Rlt zero b → Rle a b → Rle (inv b) (inv a)
  eps_between   : ∀ x y : R, Rlt x y → ∃ eps, Rlt zero eps ∧ Rlt (add x eps) y
  archimedean   : ∀ x : R, ∃ n, Rle x (INR n)
  completeness  : ∀ (A : R → Prop),
    (∃ ub, ∀ a, A a → Rle ub a) →
    ∃ sup, (∀ a, A a → Rle a sup) ∧ ∀ y, (∀ a, A a → Rle a y) → Rle sup y

open.content: open CompleteOrderedField (R zero one add mul opp inv Rle Rlt Rabs INR NatAltle)

up_bounds.content:
def up_bounds (A : R → Prop) : R → Prop :=
  fun x => ∀ a, A a → a <=R x

is_maximum.content:
def is_maximum (a : R) (A : R → Prop) : Prop :=
  A a ∧ up_bounds A a

add_sub_cancel_r.content:
theorem add_sub_cancel_r (a b : R) :
    a + (b - a) = b :=
by
  rw [←F.add_assoc]
  rw [F.add_comm]
  rw [←F.add_assoc]
  rw [F.add_opp]
  rw [F.add_comm]
  rw [F.add_zero]

Rabs_pos.content:
theorem Rabs_pos (t : R) : t <=R |t| :=
by
  have H := F.Rle_abs t
  rw [F.sub_zero] at H
  exact H

unique_max.content:
theorem unique_max (A : R → Prop) (x y : R) :
    x is_a_max_of A → y is_a_max_of A → x = y :=
by
  rintro ⟨HxA, Hx⟩ ⟨HyA, Hy⟩
  apply F.Rle_antisym
  · apply Hy; exact HxA
  · apply Hx; exact HyA

low_bounds.content:
def low_bounds (A : R → Prop) : R → Prop :=
  fun x => ∀ a, A a → x <=R a

is_inf.content:
def is_inf (x : R) (A : R → Prop) : Prop :=
  is_maximum x (low_bounds A)

inf_lt.content:
theorem inf_lt (A : R → Prop) (x : R) :
    x is_an_inf_of A → ∀ y, x <R y → ∃ a, A a ∧ a <R y :=
by
  intro Hinf y Hlt
  rcases Hinf with ⟨Hlow, Hmax⟩
  cases classic (∃ a, A a ∧ a <R y) with
  | inl Hex => exact Hex
  | inr Hnex =>
      have Hlb : low_bounds A y :=
        fun a Ha =>
          match F.Rtotal_order y a with
          | Or.inl Hya =>
              (F.Rlt_def y a).mp Hya |>.1
          | Or.inr (Or.inl Heq) =>
              Heq ▸ F.Rle_refl y
          | Or.inr (Or.inr Hay) =>
              False.elim (Hnex ⟨a, Ha, Hay⟩)
      let Hmax_y := Hmax y Hlb
      specialize Hmax y Hlb
      let ⟨Hxly, Hneq⟩ := (F.Rlt_def x y).mp Hlt
      have Hxy := F.Rle_antisym x y Hxly Hmax_y
      subst Hxy
      contradiction

le_of_le_add_eps.content:
-- Epsilon inequality
theorem le_of_le_add_eps (x y : R) :
    (∀ eps, eps >R F.zero → y <=R (x + eps)) → y <=R x :=
by
  intro H
  match F.Rtotal_order y x with
  | Or.inl Hlt =>
      exact (F.Rlt_def y x).mp Hlt |>.1
  | Or.inr (Or.inl Heq) =>
      rw [Heq]; exact F.Rle_refl x
  | Or.inr (Or.inr Hgt) =>
      obtain ⟨eps, Heps, Hxp⟩ := F.eps_between x y Hgt
      specialize H eps Heps
      let ⟨Hxp_le, Hxp_neq⟩ := (F.Rlt_def (x + eps) y).mp Hxp
      exfalso
      apply Hxp_neq
      exact F.Rle_antisym (x + eps) y Hxp_le H

le_lim.content:
theorem le_lim (x y : R) (u : Nat → R) :
    limit u x → (∀ n : Nat, y <=R u n) → y <=R x :=
by
  intros Hlim Hle
  apply le_of_le_add_eps
  intro eps Heps
  obtain ⟨N, HN⟩ := Hlim eps Heps
  apply F.Rle_trans y (u N) (x + eps) (Hle N)
  apply F.Rle_trans (u N) (x + (u N - x)) (x + eps)
  · rw [add_sub_cancel_r]
    exact F.Rle_refl (u N)
  · apply F.Rplus_le_compat_l
    apply F.Rle_trans (u N - x) (|u N - x|) eps
    · apply Rabs_pos
    · exact HN N (Nat.le_refl N)

inv_succ_pos.content:
theorem inv_succ_pos (n : F.NatAlt) : F.zero <R /F.INR (F.Succ n) :=
  by
  apply F.Rinv_0_lt_compat
  apply F.INR_pos

nat_le_S.content: axiom nat_le_S : ∀ N n : Nat, N ≤ n → N ≤ Nat.succ n

limit_inv_succ.content:
theorem limit_inv_succ (eps : R) (Heps : eps >R F.zero) :
    ∃ N, ∀ n : F.NatAlt, N <= n → /F.INR (F.Succ n) <=R eps :=
by
  let x := /eps
  have Hx_pos : F.zero <R x := by
    apply F.Rinv_0_lt_compat
    exact Heps
  obtain ⟨N, Harch⟩ := F.archimedean x
  let N1 := F.Succ N
  exists N1
  intros n Hn
  have H_INR_le : F.INR N1 <=R F.INR (F.Succ n) :=
    F.INR_le N1 (F.Succ n) (F.le_succ_of_le N1 n Hn)
  have H_INR_pos : F.zero <R F.INR (F.Succ n) :=
    F.INR_pos n
  have H_INR_N_pos : F.zero <R F.INR N1 :=
    F.INR_pos N
  apply F.Rle_trans
  · exact F.Rle_inv_contravar (F.INR N1) (F.INR (F.Succ n)) H_INR_N_pos H_INR_pos H_INR_le
  have Harch1 : x <=R F.INR N1 := F.Rle_trans x (F.INR N) (F.INR N1) Harch (F.INR_le N N1 (F.le_succ N))
  apply F.Rle_trans
  · exact F.Rle_inv_contravar x (F.INR N1) Hx_pos H_INR_N_pos Harch1
  rw [F.Rinv_involutive _ Heps]
  exact F.Rle_refl eps

Definition up_bounds (A : R -> Prop) (x : R) : Prop :=
    forall a, A a -> Rle a x.

add_sub_cancel_r.content:
Lemma add_sub_cancel_r : forall a b : R,
  a + (b - a) = b.
Proof.
  intros a b.
  unfold minus.
  rewrite <- add_assoc.
  rewrite add_comm.
  rewrite <- add_assoc.
  rewrite add_opp.
  rewrite add_comm.
  rewrite add_zero.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Rabs_pos.content:
Lemma Rabs_pos (t : R) : t <=R |t|.
    Proof.
    pose proof (Rle_abs t) as H.
    rewrite sub_zero in H.
    exact H.
    Qed.

unique_max.content:
Lemma unique_max (A : R -> Prop) (x y : R) :
    x is_a_max_of A -> y is_a_max_of A -> x = y.
  Proof.
    intros [HxA Hx] [HyA Hy].
    apply Rle_antisym; [apply Hy| apply Hx]; assumption.
  Qed.

low_bounds.content:
Definition low_bounds (A : R -> Prop) : R -> Prop :=
    fun x => forall a, A a -> x <=R a.

is_inf.content:
Definition is_inf (x : R) (A : R -> Prop) : Prop :=
    is_maximum x (low_bounds A).

inf_lt.content:
Lemma inf_lt (A : R -> Prop) (x : R) :
    x is_an_inf_of A -> forall y, x <R y -> exists a, A a /\ a <R y.
  Proof.
  intros Hinf y Hlt.
  unfold is_inf, is_maximum, up_bounds, low_bounds in Hinf.
  destruct Hinf as [Hlow Hmax].
  destruct (classic (exists a, A a /\ a <R y)) as [Hex | Hnex].
  - exact Hex.
  - assert (Hlb: low_bounds A y).
    { intros a Ha.
      destruct (Rtotal_order y a) as [Hya | [Heq | Hay]].
      + apply (proj1 (Rlt_def _ _)) in Hya. apply Hya.
      + rewrite Heq. apply Rle_refl.
      + exfalso. apply Hnex. exists a. split; [assumption|apply Hay].
    }
    specialize (Hmax y Hlb).
    apply (proj1 (Rlt_def _ _)) in Hlt as [Hxly Hneq].
    apply Rle_antisym in Hmax; [|exact Hxly].
    subst y. contradiction.
  Qed.

le_of_le_add_eps.content:
Lemma le_of_le_add_eps (x y : R) :
    (forall eps, eps >R zero -> y <=R x + eps) -> y <=R x.
  Proof. 
    intros H.
    destruct (Rtotal_order y x) as [Hlt | [Heq | Hgt]].
    - now apply (proj1 (Rlt_def _ _)) in Hlt.
    - rewrite Heq; apply Rle_refl.
    - destruct (eps_between _ _ Hgt) as [eps [Heps Hxp]].
        specialize (H eps Heps).
        apply Rlt_def in Hxp as [Hxp_le Hxp_neq].
        exfalso.
        apply Hxp_neq.
        apply Rle_antisym; [exact Hxp_le | exact H].
  Qed.

limit.content:
Definition limit (u : NatAlt -> R) (l : R) : Prop :=
    forall eps, eps >R zero -> exists N, forall n : NatAlt, (N <= n) -> |u n - l| <=R eps.

le_lim.content:
Lemma le_lim (x y : R) (u : NatAlt -> R) :
  limit u x -> (forall n : NatAlt, y <=R u n) -> y <=R x.
  Proof.
    intros Hlim Hle.
    apply le_of_le_add_eps; intros eps Heps.
    destruct (Hlim _ Heps) as [N HN].
    specialize (HN N (NatAltle_n _)).
    apply Rle_trans with (y := u N).
    - apply Hle.
    - apply Rle_trans with (y := x + (u N - x)).
      + rewrite add_sub_cancel_r. apply Rle_refl.
      + apply Rplus_le_compat_l.
        apply Rle_trans with (y := |u N - x|).
        * apply Rabs_pos.
        * apply HN.
  Qed.

inv_succ_pos.content:
Lemma inv_succ_pos : forall n, zero <R / INR (Succ n).
  Proof. intro n; apply Rinv_0_lt_compat, INR_pos. Qed.

nat_le_S.content: Axiom nat_le_S : forall N n : NatAlt, (N <= n) -> (N <= Succ n).

limit_inv_succ.content:
Lemma limit_inv_succ : forall eps : R, eps >R zero ->
    exists N, forall n : NatAlt, (N <= n) -> / INR (Succ n) <=R eps.
  Proof.
    intros eps Heps.
    set (x := / eps) in *.
    assert (Hx_pos : zero <R x).
    { unfold x; apply Rinv_0_lt_compat; exact Heps. }
    destruct (archimedean x) as [N Harch].
    set (N1 := Succ N).
    exists N1; intros n Hn.
    assert (H_INR_le : INR N1 <=R INR (Succ n)).
    { apply INR_le. apply nat_le_S. exact Hn. }
    assert (H_INR_pos : zero <R INR (Succ n)).
    { apply INR_pos. }
    assert (H_INR_N_pos : zero <R INR N1).
    { apply INR_pos. }
    apply Rle_trans with (y := / INR N1).
  - apply Rle_inv_contravar; try assumption.
  - apply Rle_trans with (y := / x).
    + unfold x in Harch. apply Rle_inv_contravar; try assumption.
      apply Rle_trans with (y := INR N).
      * apply Harch.
      * apply INR_le. apply nat_le_S, NatAltle_n.
    + unfold x. 
      assert (Hxx: zero <R / eps) by (apply Rinv_0_lt_compat; exact Heps).
      rewrite (Rinv_involutive eps Heps).
      apply Rle_refl.
  Qed.

  | Or.inr (Or.inr Hgt) =>
      obtain ⟨eps, Heps, Hxp⟩ := F.eps_between x y Hgt
      specialize H eps Heps
      let ⟨Hxp_le, Hxp_neq⟩ := (F.Rlt_def (x + eps) y).mp Hxp
      exfalso
      apply Hxp_neq
      exact F.Rle_antisym (x + eps) y Hxp_le H

coq.statement:
Lemma le_of_le_add_eps (x y : R) :
     (forall eps, eps >R zero -> y <=R x + eps) -> y <=R x.
coq.proof:
Proof. 
  intros H.
  destruct (Rtotal_order y x) as [Hlt | [Heq | Hgt]].
  - now apply (proj1 (Rlt_def _ _)) in Hlt.
  - rewrite Heq; apply Rle_refl.
  - destruct (eps_between _ _ Hgt) as [eps [Heps Hxp]].
      specialize (H eps Heps).
      apply Rlt_def in Hxp as [Hxp_le Hxp_neq].
      exfalso.
      apply Hxp_neq.
      apply Rle_antisym; [exact Hxp_le | exact H].
Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem le_lim (x y : R) (u : F.NatAlt → R) :
    limit u x → (∀ n : F.NatAlt, y <=R u n) → y <=R x := by
lean.proof:
intros Hlim Hle
  apply le_of_le_add_eps
  intro eps Heps
  obtain ⟨N, HN⟩ := Hlim eps Heps
  apply F.Rle_trans y (u N) (x + eps) (Hle N)
  apply F.Rle_trans (u N) (x + (u N - x)) (x + eps)
  · rw [add_sub_cancel_r]
    exact F.Rle_refl (u N)
  · apply F.Rplus_le_compat_l
    apply F.Rle_trans (u N - x) (|u N - x|) eps
    · apply Rabs_pos
    · exact HN N (F.NatAltle_n N)

coq.statement: Lemma le_lim (x y : R) (u : NatAlt -> R) : limit u x -> (forall n : NatAlt, y <=R u n) -> y <=R x.
coq.proof:
Proof.
  intros Hlim Hle.
  apply le_of_le_add_eps; intros eps Heps.
  destruct (Hlim _ Heps) as [N HN].
  specialize (HN N (NatAltle_n _)).
  apply Rle_trans with (y := u N).
  - apply Hle.
  - apply Rle_trans with (y := x + (u N - x)).
    + rewrite add_sub_cancel_r. apply Rle_refl.
    + apply Rplus_le_compat_l.
      apply Rle_trans with (y := |u N - x|).
      * apply Rabs_pos.
      * apply HN.
Qed.

lean.statement: theorem inv_succ_pos (n : F.NatAlt) : F.zero <R /F.INR (F.Succ n) := by

coq.statement: Lemma inv_succ_pos : forall n, zero <R / INR (Succ n).
coq.proof: Proof. intro n; apply Rinv_0_lt_compat, INR_pos. Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem limit_inv_succ (eps : R) (Heps : eps >R F.zero) :
    ∃ N, ∀ n : F.NatAlt, N <= n → /F.INR (F.Succ n) <=R eps := by
lean.proof:
let x := /eps
  have Hx_pos : F.zero <R x := by
    apply F.Rinv_0_lt_compat
    exact Heps
  obtain ⟨N, Harch⟩ := F.archimedean x
  let N1 := F.Succ N
  exists N1
  intros n Hn
  have H_INR_le : F.INR N1 <=R F.INR (F.Succ n) :=
    F.INR_le N1 (F.Succ n) (F.le_succ_of_le N1 n Hn)
  have H_INR_pos : F.zero <R F.INR (F.Succ n) :=
    F.INR_pos n
  have H_INR_N_pos : F.zero <R F.INR N1 :=
    F.INR_pos N
  apply F.Rle_trans
  · exact F.Rle_inv_contravar (F.INR N1) (F.INR (F.Succ n)) H_INR_N_pos H_INR_pos H_INR_le
  have Harch1 : x <=R F.INR N1 := F.Rle_trans x (F.INR N) (F.INR N1) Harch (F.INR_le N N1 (F.le_succ N))
  apply F.Rle_trans
  · exact F.Rle_inv_contravar x (F.INR N1) Hx_pos H_INR_N_pos Harch1
  rw [F.Rinv_involutive _ Heps]
  exact F.Rle_refl eps

coq.statement:
Lemma limit_inv_succ : forall eps : R, eps >R zero ->
  exists N, forall n : NatAlt, (N <= n) -> / INR (Succ n) <=R eps.
coq.proof:
intros eps Heps.
    set (x := / eps) in *.
    assert (Hx_pos : zero <R x) by (unfold x; apply Rinv_0_lt_compat; exact Heps).
    destruct (archimedean x) as [N Harch].
    set (N1 := Succ N).
    exists N1; intros n Hn.
    assert (H_INR_le : INR N1 <=R INR (Succ n)).
    { apply INR_le. apply le_succ_of_le. exact Hn. }
    assert (H_INR_pos : zero <R INR (Succ n)) by apply INR_pos.
    assert (H_INR_N_pos : zero <R INR N1) by apply INR_pos.
    apply Rle_trans with (y := / INR N1).
    - apply Rle_inv_contravar; try assumption.
    - apply Rle_trans with (y := / x).
      + (* use archimedean bound x <= INR N <= INR (Succ N) = INR N1 *)
        apply Rle_inv_contravar; try assumption.
        apply Rle_trans with (y := INR N).
        * exact Harch.
        * apply INR_le. apply le_succ.
      + unfold x. rewrite (Rinv_involutive eps Heps). apply Rle_refl.
